purpose: Teach: 嘆く/本性/有様/人道的/勇敢/執念/スクープ/高学年

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者さんが、本気で、絶対、病状を、絶対、嘆く、絶対、姿、絶対、医療現場でよく見ます、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Ren, I see patients in real despair about their condition quite often in the clinic.
lines.style: Steady, observant tone. Clear and direct without harshness. Pause after his name. The weight of experience sitting quietly beneath the words.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 極限状態で、本気で、絶対、人の本性、絶対、現れる、絶対、と、絶対、聞きます、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I've heard that in extreme situations, people's true nature really does come to the surface.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly hesitant. Genuine curiosity asking for confirmation. Respectful address of 'sensei' — the student thinking out loud with permission.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。救急の現場の、本気で、絶対、有様、絶対、想像、絶対、を超えるものがあります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. What you see in an emergency room — it's beyond what most people can imagine.
lines.style: Quiet firmness. Not explaining, but confirming. A pause before the second sentence. The weight of having witnessed it herself.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療従事者の、本気で、絶対、人道的、絶対、姿勢、絶対、尊敬しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I have great respect for how humanitarian medical workers are, even in those moments.
lines.style: Soft, sincere. Not performative respect — genuine. Slightly formal register befitting a student to a teacher. The third hour of conversation kindness.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。患者さんの中に、本気で、絶対、勇敢に、絶対、病と戦う方、絶対、いらっしゃいます、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. There are patients who fight their illness with real courage. I see that.
lines.style: Calm affirmation. Not celebratory, but acknowledging. Slight warmth — the moment when a doctor allows herself to say what she's witnessed with satisfaction.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 治療への、本気で、絶対、執念、絶対、患者さんと、絶対、医療者で、絶対、共有されているんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: That kind of determination — it's something the patient and the medical team share together, isn't it.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly trailing upward at the end. Recognition of something larger than the individual. Ren thinking aloud, inviting the teacher's quiet nod.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。新治療法、本気で、絶対、各紙の、絶対、スクープ、絶対、医療界、絶対、注目しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The new treatment approaches — the medical field is watching them carefully. It matters.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but with underlying significance. Not enthusiastic, but steady. The tone of someone who reads the journals and knows what's happening.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 地域の高学年児童、本気で、絶対、健康教室、絶対、続けられているんですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: And the health education classes for the older elementary students in the community — you've kept those going, haven't you, sensei.
lines.style: Soft admiration. Recognition of sustained effort. Gentle question that isn't really a question. Ren noticing what a teacher does beyond the clinic walls.
